company: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc.)

ownership.quote: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon that provides on-demand cloud computing platforms and APIs to individuals, companies, and governments, on a metered, pay-as-you-go basis.

stage.quote: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (AWS) is a subsidiary of Amazon
stage.note: EC2 is a service within AWS, a wholly-owned division of publicly traded Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN). Not independently funded; no accelerator/VC history applies.

revenue.basis: AWS segment revenue as reported in Amazon.com's Q4/FY2025 earnings release, cited by Wikipedia's AWS infobox.

note: AWS EC2 is a product line inside AWS, itself a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. (public company, NASDAQ: AMZN). Figures above are for the whole AWS segment, not EC2 alone; EC2-specific revenue is not broken out by Amazon. Amazon.com as a whole reported ~$638B total net sales for FY2024 (not used here since AWS segment revenue is more relevant).
